name: parallel-decomp-overlap-engine
title: Story 1 — Static overlap engine: computeWriteSet + globsOverlap
description: Implement the static, tiered glob-overlap engine for the parallel-decomposition gate (spec docs/parallel-decomposition-spec.md Section 4.2): computeWriteSet(contract) and globsOverlap(a,b) with literal-path intersection plus shared-directory-prefix heuristic and broadness classification, plus the scope_contract_set grammar validator that rejects mid-path ** and bare *. Lives in a NEW file core/parallel-decomposition-overlap.ts so it is file-disjoint from Story 2 (gate verdict) and runs in parallel.
